title: Unit Event — To The Gleaming Stars Halfway Through a Dream — Episode8 I Want To See Them Shine

meta.Event: To The Gleaming Stars Halfway Through a Dream
meta.Episode: Episode8 — I Want To See Them Shine
meta.Event Outline: Following their New Year's performance, everyone from Wonderlands×Showtime returns to their daily lives. During this time, Emu hears that Tsukasa's going to enroll in a workshop and is happy to hear that he's taking a step towards making his dream come true, but...

rows.Line: Multipurpose Auditorium

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow...! This place is really nice considering it's only meant for invited guests!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I wasn't expecting them to be performing in a place like this.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The director at the helm is very famous, so I'm sure he was able to call in a favor to book this venue.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Anyway, let's sit...here!
We should be able to see Tsukasa really well and cheer for him!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This isn't one of those anime cheer screenings...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, this show could involve some direct interactions with the audience. We still haven't been told what they'll be performing, yes?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
True...
Our tickets only said, “Final Assessment Show”.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What do you think they're gonna do?! Tsukasa said we'd have to wait until the curtains go up, but I'm so excited to see!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, so am I since it's rare for us to watch him perform as members of the audience.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So is not performing with you as his director. I'm also pretty excited about...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's starting...

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “We begin our story in London, England where three siblings are faced with a sudden surprise.”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “One night, their beloved dog began barking as if she were trying to scare off something.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Huh? Isn't this...?)

rows.Speaker: Wendy
rows.Line: “Nana, why are you barking so much? Don't you know what time it is...?”

rows.Speaker: John
rows.Line: “It's awfully rare of her to bark this much. She's smart and usually very quiet... What happened? You're going to wake everyone up—”

rows.Speaker: Michael
rows.Line: “John, wait! I don't think we're alone!”

rows.Speaker: John
rows.Line: “What?!”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “Behind the lace curtain, they see the strange shadow of what appears to be a person as revealed by the moonlight.”

rows.Speaker: Wendy
rows.Line: “You must be...”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Yeah, it has to be...)

rows.Speaker: Wendy
rows.Line: “Peter Pan?!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(I love this story so much...!
I've been wanting to do a show about forever!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (And that shadowy figure...isn't that...?!)

rows.Speaker: Peter Pan
rows.Line:
“So, you noticed me...
Your dog took shadow away from me, so I'm here to get it back.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (It's him... Tsukasa's Peter Pan.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wow, so he's the lead...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
It seems so.
This explains why he stayed quiet until today.

rows.Speaker: Wendy
rows.Line:
“Are you really Peter Pan...?
From that fairytale about Neverland?”

rows.Speaker: Peter Pan
rows.Line:
“Yes, the very same.
I know Neverland like the back of my own hand.”

rows.Speaker: Michael
rows.Line:
“So, the Mermaid Lagoon's real?
And the forest of children...? And Tinker Bell?!”

rows.Speaker: Peter Pan
rows.Line:
“Yes, they all exist.
Including the ever-annoying Captain Hook and his gang of pirates.”

rows.Speaker: Wendy
rows.Line:
“That means...
You can really fly wherever you like?”

rows.Speaker: Peter Pan
rows.Line: “Yes, of course. Not only that...”

rows.Speaker: Peter Pan
rows.Line:
“So can you if you truly believe.
Wherever you like, beyond your wildest dreams...”

rows.Speaker: Peter Pan
rows.Line: “And at the end, Neverland awaits!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
The way Tsukasa moved just now...
It's like he's the real Peter Pan...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I get that he should since he's playing Peter Pan, but...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I see...
The portrayal of his character involves very careful footwork.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Careful footwork?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes.
Take a closer look at him.

rows.Speaker: Peter Pan
rows.Line:
“You can do it too. It's easy.
All you have to do is have the courage to take the first step.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: When he says his lines, his feet aren't planted to the ground. He's essentially dancing on his tip-toes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's a way to show that he is in fact Peter Pan and knows how to fly. And that he is no ordinary person.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Really, it's extraordinary... And yet, it all seems natural. He must've worked very hard to make it appear so...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He learned how to do all that in such a short amount of time...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(This is so amazing.
Tsukasa's really shining today.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(So much that I can't look away...
It's almost like I'm a part of the story...!)

rows.Speaker: Peter Pan
rows.Line:
“So, are you ready?
Again, it's easy. All you have to do is wish as hard as you can. Then...”

rows.Speaker: Peter Pan
rows.Line: “You'll be able to fly!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I really love Tsukasa's acting style...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (He always sparkles and puts smiles on everyone's faces whenever he's on stage. So...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I'm sure he'll become a world-famous star someday.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Eventually, we'll have to say goodbye to each other because my dream is to make Phoenix Wonderland a place where everyone can smile, laugh and be happy...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I'm done hesitating. I'm going to really root for Tsukasa. And...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Like with Grandpa's dream...
I want Tsukasa to put smiles on everyone's faces all around the world.)
The next day
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you all for coming to see the show! What did you think? I'd like to hear your opinions.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, pick me, pick me!
I wanna go first!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
Emu, you have the floor!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yay!
So, umm... It was super fun!
Amazingly exciting and really, really sparkly...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It was the most ultra-wonderhoy show I've ever seen!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, I didn't expect to see you as the lead.
Plus, I was surprised to see you act in a completely different style.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah! That is wonderful to hear!
I'm glad you all enjoyed it so much!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Based on what we saw, I think it goes without saying that the workshop gave you some helpful experiences.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I did. Learning new acting techniques was nice, but being given the opportunity to have real discussions with other actors was invaluable.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I've seen a marked improvement in my acting skills, so I'd like to attend more workshops and events like this on a regular basis.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: At the same time, after performing alongside other actors, I've realized just how much fun it is when we...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: As such, we can't always cater for your interests, regardless of how much we wish we could. When that happens...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: You may be forced to make some tough decisions.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, um. It's nothing...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: For now, the workshop's over and we need to start preparing for our next show at the Wonder Stage!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I plan to use everything I've learned to take our performance to the next level!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, let's start practicing for it right away! We need to get it perfect before we go live next week!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Right. After seeing your performance, Tsukasa, it's become clear that our show has quite a bit of room left for improvement.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I agree. I wanna start from the top and see what if any parts need fixing.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Then, let's do that now!
First, we'll...
Ah, you're all here.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Keisuke! Shosuke!
What are you two doing here?! I didn't know you'd be coming today!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: We have some news to report... Or rather, a proposition.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A proposition...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Care to elaborate?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Well, they're sort of one and the same. To put it straight...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: We'd like everyone from both the Wonder Stage and the Phoenix Stage to do a show together.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The Phoenix Stage...?!
